scripts.build:grammar: cd tree-sitter-liva && tree-sitter generate && mkdir -p ../grammars && "${WASI_SDK_PATH:?Set WASI_SDK_PATH to the wasi-sdk directory}/bin/clang" -fPIC -shared -Os -Wl,--export=tree_sitter_liva -o ../grammars/liva.wasm -I src src/parser.c
scripts.build: pnpm run build:grammar && pnpm run build:extension
